segments.title: 第166章 透視眼
segments.content:
Chapter 166: X-Ray Vision

Inside the classroom of Grade 10, Class 7.

Similar to Class 8, they had also moved their desks and chairs to the walls to form a circle, while a row of desks and chairs was set up at intervals in the empty space in the center of the classroom.

Lu Wei was stationed at the very center seat. He looked at the crowd queuing behind, raised his chin slightly, and gestured for the next person.

The mini-game for Class 7 was simple and classic, called "Guess the Ball in the Cup."

The Class 7 students in charge of the game would prepare three paper cups and a small plastic ball.

In front of the participant, they would place the small plastic ball into one of the cups, then turn all three cups upside down and rapidly shuffle them for 15 seconds.

Finally, the participant had to guess which cup the small plastic ball was in.

Guessing correctly three times in a row was considered a successful completion. If they failed, they had to queue up again.

There were five Class 7 students running the game at the same time, and Lu Wei was currently one of them.

But because his hand speed was just too fast, several people had already failed at his station, causing those queuing behind to become hesitant.

They would rather wait for the people at the other four tables to finish than come to Lu Wei's station.

Otherwise, having to queue up again after failing would delay their stamp-collecting progress.

According to the Student Council's prize draw rules, the first student in each grade to complete the stamp collection would receive a full 10 chances at the draw.

The top 10 would get 8 chances.

The top 50 would get 6 chances.

The top 100 would get 4 chances.

The top 200 would get 2 chances.

After that, there was only 1 chance for the prize draw.

The mini-games in the sixteen classes were all very simple. Even including the queuing time, each class would take ten minutes at most.

There were a full three and a half hours in the morning. Even if some people needed to help out in their own classes, the remaining time was more than enough.

But the higher the rank, the more prize draws one could get, so everyone was naturally happy to race against the clock.

"That person in the middle seems a bit tough." When it was Ying Chanxi and Li Luo's turn, Ying Chanxi couldn't help but whisper, "Should we wait for another spot?"

Li Luo glanced at Lu Wei, who was exuding the aura of an expert, and the corner of his mouth twitched. "Yeah, whatever you want."

Unfortunately, the two of them were quite conspicuous in the crowd.

Lu Wei spotted Li Luo in the crowd at a glance and immediately called out to him, "Li Luo! Come on, as the class president of Class 8, you're not scared of a little game like this, are you? Are you trying to avoid me?"

Li Luo: "..."

Instantly feeling the gazes from the surrounding students, Li Luo's eye twitched. He was a bit speechless at Lu Wei's antics.

He sighed and whispered into Ying Chanxi's ear, "You go first in a bit. If I put my hand on your right shoulder, it's the right cup. Left shoulder, left cup. If I pat your back, it's the one in the middle."

"Oh, okay..." Ying Chanxi's ear tickled from his breath. Whispering in front of so many people made her cheeks flush slightly red.

And so, under Lu Wei's "enthusiastic invitation," Li Luo and Ying Chanxi walked up to Lu Wei's table.

Ying Chanxi sat down first.

Lu Wei looked at Ying Chanxi, and his imposing aura suddenly deflated.

After all, she was a girl much prettier than Gao Yuqin. Moreover, Lu Wei himself liked to mingle in various circles and knew a fair bit about Ying Chanxi.

This was the top academic prodigy of the entire school.

The moment he saw Ying Chanxi, Lu Wei immediately behaved himself.

But since Ying Chanxi had come with Li Luo, Lu Wei wouldn't go easy on her.

He chuckled softly, his fingers skillfully picking up a small plastic ball and placing it into a paper cup.

The next second, he deftly flipped the three cups upside down on the table.

Who would have thought that this burly guy had such nimble fingers. Unlike the other students from Class 7 next to him, the cups in his hands seemed to come alive, rapidly shifting and changing positions.

Originally, Ying Chanxi had planned to pass using her own skills.

But Lu Wei's hand speed was just too fast. In just 15 seconds, the three cups had been swapped back and forth at least several dozen times.

This guy especially liked to stop halfway through a swap and then quickly switch to the other side, instantly breaking one's concentration.

The slightest lapse in attention, and you would immediately lose sight of the cup with the small plastic ball.

Once you forgot which cup the ball was in, the game became a complete blind guess based on probability.

"Alright." Lu Wei confidently pushed the three cups in front of Ying Chanxi and gestured with his hand, "Please."

Others might not know, but Lu Wei was very clear about his own skills.

After all, back in elementary school, he was so obsessed with magic that he had specifically asked his parents to enroll him in a magic interest class.

A simple little game like this was quite easy for him.

He could even perform magic tricks with these cups and a ball.

But since it was just a mini-game, he couldn't bully people like that, so he only relied on his hand speed to dazzle them.

For those who were not sufficiently prepared, this alone was more than enough.

At this moment, Ying Chanxi stared at the three cups, truly a little unsure.

Because it seemed she had lost track once in the middle. She felt it was the one on the right, but then again, maybe not.

When Li Luo gently placed his hand on her left shoulder, Ying Chanxi turned to look at him. Seeing him nod slightly, she chose to trust him and reached out to lift the left cup.

As expected.

A small plastic ball lay quietly inside.

"Holy crap, I didn't even see it," a student queuing behind couldn't help but exclaim. "Was that a blind guess?"

Lu Wei, sitting opposite, was also a little surprised, but he just assumed Ying Chanxi had gotten lucky.

After all, even picking one at random gave her a one-in-three chance of being right.

But this mini-game required three consecutive correct guesses to pass, so Lu Wei wasn't worried.

Thus, he once again displayed his technique, dazzling Ying Chanxi's eyes with pure hand speed.

But in the following two rounds...

Feeling Li Luo's hand on her right shoulder and then her back, Ying Chanxi easily claimed victory in the game.

"Thanks." After getting her stamp from a nearby Class 7 student, Ying Chanxi smilingly gave up her seat and let Li Luo sit down. "Your turn."

Watching Li Luo sit down in front of him, Lu Wei, who had been a bit bothered by Ying Chanxi's win, now tossed it to the back of his mind and focused his full attention on Li Luo.

"Bring it on."

Li Luo glanced at him, sensing the guy's inexplicable competitive spirit flaring up. He felt rather speechless and just wanted to get it over with, get the stamp, and leave. "Hurry up."

"Hmph, just you wait."

Lu Wei snorted coldly, placed the plastic ball into a cup, and then began shuffling them at astonishing speed. The cups under his hands were like fluttering butterflies, their speed even a bit faster than before.

There were even afterimages.

But when he stopped the cups and asked Li Luo to guess, Li Luo just casually reached out, lifted the cup on the right, and the small ball lay there quietly.

The spectating students all exclaimed in surprise, because they really hadn't seen it clearly.

Lu Wei's hand speed was too fast. What should have been a fairly simple mini-game was turned into something like an extreme challenge by him.

But Li Luo had easily cracked it and guessed the puzzle.

This made Lu Wei a little unhappy.

He placed the plastic ball back into a cup. This time, a thought struck him. While maintaining the same speed, he added a little sleight of hand.

Li Luo still looked absent-minded, but when Lu Wei finished shuffling, the memory palace in Li Luo's mind was furiously rewinding.

Then, the corner of Li Luo's mouth twitched. He saw a certain frame in his memory where Lu Wei, with a swift move, had imperceptibly pushed the plastic ball from the right cup into another cup that was slightly lifted at an angle.

This was completely a magic trick.

He was purely trying to trip up Li Luo. If it had been any other student, Lu Wei definitely wouldn't have made it so difficult.

If it weren't for Li Luo's memory palace, he would have really been tricked.

But now, he was full of confidence. He opened the middle cup, and the plastic ball lay there quietly.

At this, Lu Wei's expression instantly changed.

He glanced at Li Luo. Seeing that he said nothing, Lu Wei was unsure if this guy had noticed or not.

Could it be that he really just guessed it right?

Lu Wei didn't believe it. He gritted his teeth and took control of the cups again.

Li Luo stared intently at the three cups in his hands, and the memory palace in his mind began to operate.

Finally, he looked speechlessly at Lu Wei, who had stopped, and said to him, "Are you sure you want to do this?"

"Do what?" Lu Wei asked back, his expression natural and his face calm.

Li Luo sighed. "Then I'll guess?"

"Go ahead."

Seeing that Lu Wei was still not giving up, Li Luo shook his head helplessly. Then he suddenly stood up, shot out a hand, and grabbed Lu Wei's wrist.

The next second, a small plastic ball slipped from his palm, clattering onto the floor and rolling far away.

Then, Li Luo said, "There are no balls in any of the three cups."

Lu Wei looked at him with an ugly expression, his face alternating between red and white.

The students nearby were also somewhat bewildered, looking at Lu Wei with suspicion.

Meanwhile, Ying Chanxi had already curiously reached out and opened the three cups on the table.

There really wasn't a single ball!

"Isn't that going a bit too far?" A student queuing behind said speechlessly. "You're basically doing a magic trick now. Are you kidding me?"

"N-no." Lu Wei quickly explained, "I didn't do that before, only just that once."

"Alright, alright." Li Luo stood up and had a Class 7 student stamp his sheet. Then he waved his hand and said, "We're leaving. You guys have fun."

With that, he led Ying Chanxi out of the Class 7 classroom.

"How did you figure it out?"

In the hallway, Ying Chanxi asked Li Luo with a curious look on her face.

"I have X-ray vision. Do you believe me?"

"Eww, gross."

"Wait... how is that gross?" Li Luo looked speechless. "Why are you covering your chest?"

"Didn't you say you have X-ray vision?"

"If I really had it, covering it with your hands would be useless." Li Luo said, "Besides, you're not that..."

"Shut up!"

(End of Chapter)
